name: BazarCompare AI
model_pipeline: Tesseract OCR + multilingual product matching + per-unit normalization + historical price model only on permitted time series

model_candidates.name: Tesseract OCR with ben+eng language packs
model_candidates.must_smoke_test: Extract Bangla digits/Latin amounts from owned sample image; low-confidence flag

model_candidates.name: sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
model_candidates.must_smoke_test: Encode two real Bengali strings and assert different finite vectors; search should return expected source ID

model_candidates.name: scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingRegressor / RandomForestRegressor
model_candidates.must_smoke_test: Dataset has sufficient lawful historical rows; fit/test with MAE vs naive baseline, no leakage

evaluation: Commodity matching top-k; price unit conversion QA; walk-forward MAE

hard_safety_limit: Never present demo prices as current official prices
simple_user_flow: receipt/text list > normalize units > compare verified prices
advanced_features: freshness/provenance label, local market selector, budget compare
